title: Personal blocks and redirects expose the reserved numeric source
reproduction: Block a new host in Checker then compare its explanation with an allow on that host.
expected: Use the localized user list name for all user rule types.
observed: Reference APK displays User rule: Source 1 for both block and redirect; allow displays User rule: User list.
fix: Resolve the reserved source ID consistently before consulting the external source list.
test_evidence: API30: exact-block.jpg vs visible.log#public-blocked and he-suffix-fixed.jpg; DomainCheckerRuleScopeInstrumentedTest passed. Exact build IDs in journeys CSV.

title: Inherited decisions offer a removal that cannot take effect
reproduction: Open recorded www.googleadservices.com with only source IDs 2 and 3; tap Remove entry from block list and Apply.
expected: Keep inherited rule read-only; offer removal only for enabled exact personal rule of selected type. Unlisted host should not imply an exact allow.
observed: Original row cleared selection and offered Apply while source rules and actual blocked DNS answer were unchanged.
fix: Track whether the effective type has a matching personal exact rule; disable inherited selection, distinguish default forwarding, scope removal by type and refresh from storage.
test_evidence: API30 visible.log#log-before-inherited-remove/#log-after-inherited-remove/#patched-ltr-log/#log-remove-exception; dns.log 19:40:32 and 19:49:26; three real adapter tests passed. Related SUP-AUD-003 addressed spoken action mapping, not rule ownership.

title: Checking a child offers deletion of a shared suffix block
reproduction: Seed a personal block suffix in scratch storage; check its child. Baseline Delete button was observed, not activated.
expected: Explain the matched rule without allowing a child action to remove protection for siblings.
observed: Child screen showed generic personal source plus Delete Rule; baseline mutation path matched the suffix row ID. No live shared-rule deletion performed.
fix: Show suffix pattern as read-only; delete only matching exact user block/redirect rows and reject mismatched IDs.
test_evidence: API30 visible.log#suffix-child vs he-suffix-fixed.jpg; DomainCheckerRuleScopeInstrumentedTest exercised rejected child delete and checked stored parent and sibling; dns.log 19:48:50/19:49:21. Related PB-DATA-005 applies to allow provenance, not blocking-suffix deletion.

title: Visible Checker workflow falls back to English on a Hebrew device
reproduction: Set Android system language he-IL first; return to checker and inspect input, status, advice and actions.
expected: Use Hebrew UI copy with visible domain names and source names preserved.
observed: Headline, Check, placeholder and rule advice were English before patch; system and layout used RTL.
fix: Localized the observed Checker controls and feedback; the integrated build includes the More-owned title.
test_evidence: Old he-before.jpg vs he-suffix-fixed.jpg; final signed 65-final-he-checker confirms integrated title/input/action. API 34 debug: he-IL confirmed before and after forced SQLite insert failure, restored visible error and successful persisted retry, 2.213 s. Checked the packaged Hebrew error resource. See deep-signoff/pending-apply-and-locale.md.

title: Hebrew DNS log hides hostnames and overlaps three actions
reproduction: Set he-IL; record actual VPN DNS requests; inspect row bounds and text. Compare en-US at 100% and 200% font; scroll through to the final row.
expected: Distinct controls and fully readable short and wrapped hostnames in both directions and at large font.
observed: Original Hebrew rows had no visible hostname; all three targets overlapped at x=0..48. Before fix 3/4 on-device geometry variants failed: Hebrew normal/large and English large. English normal passed.
fix: Replace incomplete constraint chain with a mirrored horizontal row, fixed-dp icons and weighted wrapping hostname. Allow rows to grow and final item to scroll above the record button.
test_evidence: Same non-root API30 serial 5562; final APK a83a06c91e6eb05b9084843d65da3865865a218803eb350b910e538575e21848. geometry-before.log: 3 of 4 failed; geometry-after.log: all four geometry and three action tests passed. Live geometry-live.log and geometry-{he,en}-{100,200}.jpg: distinct mirrored targets, full hostname, final row above FAB. No TalkBack or unrelated screens claimed.

title: Custom Rules still shows English search, empty state and delete confirmation in Hebrew
reproduction: On he-IL open Redirected, select the owned test redirect and Delete; cancel, then confirm and view empty state.
expected: Search hint, empty message and confirmation should be Hebrew alongside the surrounding controls.
observed: Search domains…, Delete rule?, Delete and the two empty-state lines were English with adjacent Hebrew labels/buttons.
fix: Translate the visible Custom Rules search, empty, and delete controls in he-IL.
